method: Independent agents reviewed rule engines and exercised targeted browser counterexamples; owners fixed and retested findings. Root inspected catalog and representative screenshots.

findings.issue: Markup leaked into accessible labels and visible button text
findings.resolution: Escaped attribute helper and clean labels; screenshots and edge tests passed

findings.issue: A route reaching the goal and then hitting a wall could win
findings.resolution: Track collision failures for the entire program; legal solution wins, trailing wall step is rejected
Explicit stranded state with disabled travel controls until restart

findings.issue: Initial clues directly disclosed seating order
findings.resolution: Indirect generated constraint sets independently checked for a unique permutation

findings.issue: Arrow navigation across skipped grid cells changed columns
Valid alternate compounds were rejected by an ambiguous pack
findings.resolution: Curated unambiguous replacement pack, targeted full round retested

findings.issue: A correctly spelled word was labeled a spelling error
Keyboard dropdown lost focus after rerender
findings.resolution: Focus restoration and explicit native keyboard regression

findings.issue: Couriers could block the only route with no valid move
findings.resolution: Standard jump/side-step pawn rules for both sides; exact reported replay and random rounds retested
Tuned instability; idle loss and active-input wins independently checked

findings.issue: Sinking an intermediate green on the final stroke allowed extra shots
findings.resolution: Enforce stroke cap on shot and intermediate-hole transition; exact twelfth-shot regression

findings.issue: Initial falling-object mechanic overlapped Signal Run
findings.resolution: Redesigned as boat positioning plus lowering/reeling a fishing hook with finite casts and depth decisions
